item.title: AI Now Is a Pilot That Can Somewhat Improve Itself
item.description: On my way to the last Giants game of the season, I struck up a conversation with the guy sitting next to me. I probably shouldn’t peek at his phone, but I couldn’t help noticing he was reading an article titled “747s and Coding Agents” — at the same time, I was reading a romance novel. Speaking of the competition in the Bay Area, haha. I’ve been wanting to write this down since last Sunday, when I had this conversation with the guy sitting next to me on the CalTrain.

item.title: Six Months of Building With AI: What Broke, and What It Unlocked
item.description: ─── You’ll probably see the name “Gideon” a lot—it’s my personal assistant’s name. Let’s get it started. How it started Link to heading In March, there was a lot of hype about OpenClaw, and there were so many videos on YouTube about how people were using OpenClaw. After watching some of those, I got curious—let me see what this “OpenClaw” was. I’m the type of person who isn’t really satisfied just by listening to others, and I learn by doing.
